body: A Southwest Airlines Boeing 737-700, registration N281WN, operating flight WN-3396 from Santa Ana to San Jose with 96 people on board, was climbing out of Santa Ana's runway 02L on November 6 when the crew stopped the climb at FL200 reporting right-hand engine (CFM56) problems and decided to divert to Los Angeles. The crew subsequently shut the engine down and continued for a safe landing on Los Angeles' runway 25L about 40 minutes after departure.

The airline reported the crew received an engine maintenance indication, and the FAA reported the crew reported engine issues. The Aviation Herald reported the aircraft was still on the ground in Los Angeles about 21 hours after landing.
en.summary: A Southwest Boeing 737-700 operating flight WN-3396 from Santa Ana to San Jose stopped its climb with right-engine problems, shut the engine down and diverted to Los Angeles, landing safely about 40 minutes after departure.
en.title: Southwest 737 shuts down engine in flight and diverts to Los Angeles

body: 11月6日，西南航空一架波音737-700（註冊編號N281WN）執行WN-3396航班自聖安娜飛往聖荷西，機上96人；航機自聖安娜02L跑道起飛爬升，於FL200因右發動機（CFM56）出現問題停止爬升，決定轉降洛杉磯。機組隨後關閉該發動機，約40分鐘後平安降落洛杉磯25L跑道。
航空公司表示，機組收到發動機維護指示；美國聯邦航空總署表示，機組通報發動機出現問題。據The Aviation Herald報導，事發航機於降落約21小時後仍停留在洛杉磯。
zh.summary: 西南航空一架波音737-700執行WN-3396航班自聖安娜飛往聖荷西，爬升中右發動機出現問題，機組關閉發動機後轉降洛杉磯，約40分鐘後平安降落25L跑道。
zh.title: 西南航空737發動機故障空中關車，轉降洛杉磯平安落地
